metadata.summary: Scoped durable working candidates with attributable provenance, stable IDs and bounded lexical retrieval.

semantics.description: Create active/working author-only candidates; get/search only visible active/working records representable without truncation. Stable IDs and completed creates survive normal restart. Mandatory durable actor-key idempotency for create, at least24h retention. Host operation grants plus independently narrowed data authority; no actor/promotion/import authority in payload. Search records retrieval evidence; absence/outage distinct. See SEMANTICS.md.
